message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration features a large red "TEMPO" masthead at the top. Below the title, three figures interact on a split diagonal composition. On the left, an escalator ascends. Two figures wearing black graduation gowns and square mortarboards with yellow tassels are on this escalator. One figure leans over the handrail, pointing a finger downward. The second figure stands higher up, leaning against the rail with crossed arms. On the right, a man with white hair and glasses, wearing a light-colored shirt and dark trousers, is shown from behind as he crawls up a staircase made of oversized, thick white books with beige edges. 

The background is a flat grey. Large white text at the bottom left reads "SKANDAL GURU BESAR ABAL-ABAL." Smaller text below it mentions "jurnal predator" and "gelar guru besar." Other Indonesian text appears at the top, including "Kematian Sadis Wartawan Karo" and "Utak-atik Defisit Lewat Revisi UU Keuangan Negara." A barcode and issue information for "8-14 JULI 2024" are in the bottom right corner.
